label: Renal (low phosphorus / potassium / sodium)
clinical_basis: Thresholds are configurable defaults informed by published CKD dietary guidance (e.g. KDOQI). They are NOT medical advice and require review by a qualified renal dietitian for any patient use.

nutrient_limits.explanation: Phosphorus per serving must stay at or below the renal limit; dairy is intrinsically high in phosphorus.
Potassium per serving must stay at or below the renal limit.
Sodium per serving must stay at or below the renal limit.
